youtube.title: 🔥 This AI Orchestrator Runs 5 Agents at Once
youtube.description: Stop context-switching between Claude Code, Codex, and five other terminals. Orca is an AI orchestrator that runs multiple coding agents side-by-side in isolated git worktrees, so you can send one prompt to five agents, compare their solutions in real-time, and merge the winner with one click. It includes a mobile companion app to monitor and steer agents from your phone, Ghostty-class terminals with WebGL rendering, an embedded Chromium browser with design mode (click any UI element to send its HTML and CSS to your agent), native GitHub and Linear integrations, SSH worktrees for remote development, and a full CLI for scripting workflows. Works with any CLI agent — Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, and 20+ more. Built for developers who need to test multiple agents on the same task and want the best solution to win automatically, not guess which agent to use. Cross-platform for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Download at onOrca.dev or search GitHub for stablyai/orca.

linkedin.text:
🚨 You're burning 3+ hours a week switching between AI coding agents in different windows.

Claude Code in one tab. Codex in another. Grok somewhere else. You're copy-pasting prompts, merging conflicts manually, and losing your mind tracking which agent did what.

There's a better way: **Orca**, an open-source AI orchestrator that runs multiple agents in parallel — each in its own isolated git worktree.

✅ Send one prompt to five agents simultaneously  
✅ Compare results side-by-side in real-time  
✅ Merge the best solution with one click  

But the wild part: it has a **mobile app** so you can monitor and steer agents from your phone, get notified when they finish, and send follow-ups from anywhere.

It also packs:
🛠️ Ghostty-class terminals with infinite splits  
🛠️ Embedded browser with design mode (click any UI to send HTML/CSS to your agent)  
🛠️ Native GitHub and Linear integrations  
🛠️ SSH worktrees for remote dev on beefy boxes  
🛠️ Full CLI for scripting workflows  

Works with **any CLI agent**: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, and 20+ more.

⭐ Already 12,000+ stars on GitHub. Cross-platform for macOS, Windows, Linux.

Search GitHub for **stablyai/orca** and grab the desktop + mobile apps.

What's your biggest pain point managing multiple AI agents right now?
